content_sections.heading: NIT Arunachal Pradesh Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Arunachal Pradesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Adjunct Faculty (Guest Faculty) positions at NIT Arunachal Pradesh is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Adjunct Faculty posts?
faq.answer: For Computer Science & Engineering, candidates need First Class in B.Tech./B.E. and M.Tech./M.E. in CSE/IT/ECE. For Electronics & Communication Engineering, First Class in B.Tech./B.E. and M.Tech./M.E. in ECE is required. Ph.D. is desirable for both.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Adjunct Faculty at NIT Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Adjunct Faculty (Guest Faculty) positions. Two vacancies are for Computer Science & Engineering and one vacancy is for Electronics & Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Adjunct Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Adjunct Faculty (Guest Faculty) positions will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIT Arunachal Pradesh recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these Adjunct Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Adjunct Faculty (Guest Faculty) positions will involve a presentation by the candidates, followed by a walk-in interview conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the NIT Arunachal Pradesh located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Arunachal Pradesh is located in Jote, Arunachal Pradesh, with the pincode 791113.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Adjunct Faculty (Guest Faculty) positions at NIT Arunachal Pradesh are contractual in nature.
